observations: Black mesh-back office chair with padded armrests and chrome 5-star base on casters.
Backrest is tilted/collapsed sideways into a near-horizontal position rather than sitting upright, consistent with seller's own description 'bent'.
Headrest/neck pillow area appears detached or hanging loosely at the top of the backrest.
Seat cushion itself looks intact, no visible rips or stains in the one photo.
Background shows a home living room setting (sofas, TV stand), not a shop, consistent with private resale.
Seller's new message is text only, no additional photo or video provided.

claims.evidence: No receipt, date stamp, or purchase proof shown in photo 0 or in the reply.

claims.claim: No stain, no tear, foam still firm
claims.evidence: Seat/back fabric looks clean in photo 0, but the chair's backrest/recline mechanism is visibly bent, which contradicts an overall 'like new' claim even if fabric is fine.
Not something a photo can confirm.

claims.claim: 'I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true'
claims.evidence: A verbal assurance with no new photo or video; seller's words are data, not proof, per the standing rule.
Photo 0 shows the backrest collapsed/tilted far past a normal recline angle, matching the seller's own description.

risks.risk: Cause and extent of the bend: broken recline mechanism, cracked back frame, or stripped tilt-tension bolt
risks.proof: Close-up photo/video of the tilt mechanism and the joint where the backrest meets the seat, plus a clip of someone sitting in it to show if it holds any position
risks.if_unproven: priced as a non-functional/broken recline mechanism, i.e. not usable as a normal chair

risks.proof: Video of the height lever being pumped and the seat rising/lowering smoothly
risks.if_unproven: priced as if height adjustment may be faulty

risks.risk: Hidden tears or wear on the underside of the seat or back mesh not visible in this angle
risks.proof: Photo of the underside of the seat and a straight-on shot of the full mesh back
risks.if_unproven: priced as if tears may be present

risks.risk: Caster/wheel condition and armrest padding wear
risks.proof: Close-up photos of two or three casters and both armrests
risks.if_unproven: priced as average wear, not premium condition

proof_requests: Video showing the chair being sat in and the backrest's current tilt/lock behavior
Close-up of the recline/tilt mechanism and any visible crack or bent metal part
Photo of the chair from the front, upright, to see if it can hold a normal sitting position at all
Close-up of the underside of the seat cushion
response.reason: A text-only reassurance with no new visual evidence does not change the visible structural bend in photo 0; the item is still priced at worst case as a chair with a compromised recline mechanism until a video or close-up proves otherwise.
